cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description:
Fast and fun! A great day on the water!

With extended deck and plenty of space, the 150hp Bayliner 19’ offers a smooth ride with enough room for you and all your friends to spend the day cruising.
what_is_included:
- Max of 10 passengers *including children* (not to exceed 1200 lbs.)
- Must be 18+ to rent and drive
- 115hp Mercury outboard engine
- Beam forward hull design
- Spacious seating arrangement
- Bimini top & swim ladder
- Pets Allowed
- Life vests included (all sizes)
